description:
Job Title: Power Platform & Copilot Studio Developer 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
 
Type of Travel: None 
 
* * * 
 
 
 The Opportunity: 
As a CACI Mission and Engineering Support (M&ES) Line of Business Power Platform & Copilot Studio Developer, you will play a key role in driving our enterprise transition to the Microsoft Power Platform and O365 applications within GCC-High Cloud and DoD Cloud environments. You will leverage deep expertise in O365 tools—including SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and Copilot Studio—and advanced Power Platform technologies such as Power Apps (canvas and model-driven), Power BI, Dataverse, Power Automate, and Power Pages/Portals. A strong understanding of Azure Active Directory (AAD/Entra ID), identity management, GovCloud, and CUI-compliant data security is essential. 

 Responsibilities: 
In this role you will collaborate closely with a distributed development team where proactive communication is essential. You will design, develop, and deploy secure applications—specifically within GCC-High and DoD Cloud—that enhance business processes. The role operates on a standard Eastern Standard Time (EST) schedule and includes daily coordination with fellow Power Platform developers and the Technical Project Lead. A strong background in SharePoint Online is highly valuable. · Research and analyze requirements to determine programming needs and technical approaches · Design and develop secure Power Platform solutions using industry best practices · Apply software testing methodologies to identify and resolve defects · Collaborate with the team to ensure clean, maintainable, high-quality code · Build advanced Power BI reports and dashboards and present insights to stakeholders · Customize and optimize existing solutions to improve performance and functionality · Document solution architecture, configurations, and code changes accurately 

 Qualifications: 
 Required:  
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience developing solutions using Power Apps (canvas + model-driven), Power BI, Power Automate, Dataverse · Proven experience designing, developing, and deploying Power Platform applications and ALM/environment management · Familiarity with Agile/Scrum, user stories, and SDLC best practices · Hands-on experience integrating Microsoft 365 services and building custom connectors (REST APIs, OAuth 2.0) · Experience working in secure cloud environments such as GCC-High, DoD Cloud, Azure Government, with CUI, RBAC, Zero Trust, FedRAMP concepts · Demonstrated success collaborating with cross-functional teams (technical, development, acquisition, contracts, program management) · Data skills: DAX, Power Query/M, JSON, HTML; data modeling and transformations · Copilot Studio custom agents: conversation/topic design, prompt engineering, multi-turn dialog, grounding data, Responsible AI/content filtering · Ability to obtain a minimum Secret security clearance 
 
 Desired: · 
 Azure OpenAI Service integration with Copilot Studio; secure use in GCC-High/DoD Cloud 
 GitLab/Git and CI/CD pipelines, branching strategies, YAML
 Power Platform certifications (Fundamentals, Developer Associate, Solution Architect Expert) 
 Experience supporting Government/DoD customers
 
 
 
 
 
- 
 

 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$90,300-$189,600 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
